scenarios.name: Descriptive scenario name

context.situation: Detailed realistic scenario with specific dollar amounts, company names (fictitious but realistic), product types, customer tiers, timeline pressures, and competing priorities.

available_data.key: Specific data points the agent has access to

scenarios.task: What the agent must produce (e.g., severity assessment, action plan, communication draft, decision recommendation)

rubric.pass: Specific description of what a correct, expert-level response looks like
rubric.fail: Specific description of what an incorrect or generic response looks like
